title: hide and seek picture rpg maker mz

posts.author: galadri7
posts.body: any ideas of how to make this?

posts.author: Norintha
posts.body: If you mean like Where's Waldo or a hidden image search, that is an easy one. Make the background and all the things that aren't clickable as one picture and show them as the lower picture in the scene with the show picture command. Make the clickable items each their own image, with absolutely no extra empty space in the margins. Take the time to show each image in the exact place it needs to be (small details make the game) and after each clickable show picture use the ButtonPicture plugin that comes with MZ to make it so clicking on the picture will run a relevant common event.
